remarks: Beautiful wooded flag lot of 11 acres!  Easement access is 50' wide at road and 200' deep then opens up to 477 front and 900' depth! There are a couple of walking trails and a few open areas.  Beautiful Maple, Shagbark Hickory and Oak Trees to name a few.  Attached Survey shows 11.05 acres different from Town Records at 10.3. Some Wetlands. Very pretty Recreational land.  Great location to Hamburg Village, Chestnut Ridge Park, Orchard Park & Boston!  Please Do Not try to access the property without an appointment.
